profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company, ticker META, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, with CIK 0001326801 on file. Its most recent 10-K, covering the period ending 2025-12-31, reports revenue of $200,966,000,000. The site at llama.com presents Meta as a vendor of AI models and tools for developers, offering access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and the Meta Model API.

On the product side, the site describes Muse Spark as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and says it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. The Meta Model API is described as compatible with existing OpenAI SDK clients, with a quick start that gets a first working request in under five minutes, and a search grounding tool that gives a model live access to the web. Muse Image is offered on the Meta Model API at $0.01/image, described as a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing, with anchored composition for consistent edits. Meta also maintains Llama, an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted.

The record also lists three lawsuits naming Meta Platforms: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. California is listed as the jurisdiction with the largest litigation exposure, at 220 cases. Several MCP servers are tracked in connection with Meta, most of them for Meta Ads work: ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, described as having 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights; co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp for Facebook and Meta Ads automation; and com.adbloop/meta-ads for bulk-creating Facebook and Instagram ads across accounts from Drive folders. Others include ai.fastmetal/fastmetal for running and comparing LLMs and generating images and video, ai.livingmeta/ai-in-research, a read-only server over the LivingMeta AI-in-Research corpus of 12,400 papers, ai.primeta/primeta for 3D avatars with custom personas, and app.metadock/metadock for controlling the MetaDock desktop workspace.
